Rationale.RP1_ImplementationReconstructability: The experiment was fully reconstructable from plan.md and CodeWalkthrough.md. The plan clearly specified how to build lenses (sum OV matrices from top-k heads), extract embeddings (last token at layer l), and evaluate using nearest neighbor accuracy. All hyperparameters (k=80, layers) were documented. No guesswork was required.
Rationale.RP2_EnvironmentReproducibility: The environment was restored without issues. nnsight package was functional, Llama-2-7b-hf model loaded successfully, all data files were present, pre-computed causal scores were available in cache, and no dependency conflicts occurred.
Rationale.RP3_DeterminismAndStability: Results were fully deterministic. All 15 test configurations matched expected results exactly (within numerical precision < 0.001). No random sampling or stochastic operations were involved. Cosine similarity calculations are deterministic.
Rationale.RP4_DemoPresentation: NA - This repository supports full replication of experiments, not demo-only. The scripts all_parallelograms.py and parallelogram_ranks.py enable complete reproduction of paper results.
